pages:
為了達成2050年淨零排放目標，發展低碳能源是重要的一步。
在這個遊戲中，您可以透過趣味問答，一起認識各種再生能源的特色，了解我國未來能源發展的多元面貌。

一起來體驗吧~
pages_en:
To achieve the 2050 net-zero emissions goal, developing low-carbon energy is a crucial step.
In this game, you can explore the features of various renewable energy sources through fun quizzes and learn about the diverse landscape of Taiwan’s future energy development.

Let’s get started!

wind.title: 離岸風電知多少!
wind.title_en: How Much Do You Know About Offshore Wind?
wind.guide: 風力發電透過風吹動風機葉片帶動發電機，將風能轉換為電力。臺灣海峽風力資源豐富、風況穩定，適合發展離岸風電；未來將推動大型化與浮動式技術，提升發電量並拓展至深海與遠洋，加速能源轉型。
wind.guide_en: Wind power generation converts wind energy into electricity by using wind to turn turbine blades that drive a generator. The Taiwan Strait has abundant wind resources and stable wind conditions, making it well-suited for the development of offshore wind power. In the future, efforts will focus on larger-scale turbines and floating technologies to increase power generation and expand into deep-sea and offshore areas, accelerating the energy transition.
wind.policy: 臺灣具備優良離岸風場資源，經濟部參考國際離岸風電發展趨勢，規劃分階段推動：先從示範計畫開始，累積經驗後擴大到具潛力的場域，最後再進入大規模開發，一步一步建立離岸風電發展基礎。
wind.policy_en: Taiwan has excellent offshore wind resources. Referring to international trends in offshore wind development, the Ministry of Economic Affairs has planned a phased approach: starting with demonstration projects, then expanding to promising sites after gaining experience, and finally moving into large-scale development, step by step building the foundation for offshore wind power development.

solar.title: 太陽光電!
solar.guide: 太陽能「有光就有電」，可設置於屋頂、水面、地面及建築立面，其中以建築物屋頂為優先推動。設備維護簡單，只要定期以清水清洗、保持表面乾淨，就能維持穩定的發電效率。
solar.guide_en: Solar power follows the principle “where there is sunlight, there is electricity.” It can be installed on rooftops, water surfaces, ground areas, and building facades, with building rooftops being the priority for deployment. The equipment is easy to maintain—regular cleaning with water to keep the surface clean is sufficient to ensure stable power generation efficiency.
solar.policy: 太陽光電以屋頂型為優先，像是住宅、工廠或公共建築的屋頂，至於地面型光電，則以不影響農業、閒置或條件較不利耕作的土地為主，透過「一地兩用」，在維持土地原本功能的同時，增加綠能效益。
solar.policy_en: Rooftop solar PV is prioritized, such as installations on the roofs of residential buildings, factories, or public facilities. As for ground-mounted solar systems, they are mainly developed on land that does not affect agriculture, such as idle land or areas less suitable for cultivation. Through a “dual-use” approach, the original function of the land is maintained while increasing green energy benefits.

geothermal.title: 來自地心的強大能量!
geothermal.guide: 地熱發電利用地底熱能發電，常設於溫泉等地熱資源豐富地區，可以24小時穩定供電，作為基載電力穩定供電，是臺灣推動再生能源的重要選項。
geothermal.guide_en: Geothermal power generation uses heat from beneath the Earth’s surface to produce electricity. It is commonly installed in areas rich in geothermal resources, such as hot spring regions. It can provide stable power 24 hours a day, serving as baseload electricity, and is an important option for Taiwan in promoting renewable energy.
geothermal.policy: 政府持續發展多元綠能，其中地熱能是重要方向之一。針對淺層地熱會透過探勘補助與獎勵，鼓勵民間業者加快開發；深層地熱則由國營事業先行投入，累積經驗後再逐步擴大設置。
geothermal.policy_en: The government continues to develop diverse forms of green energy, with geothermal energy being one of the key directions. For shallow geothermal resources, exploration subsidies and incentives are provided to encourage private developers to accelerate development; for deep geothermal resources, state-owned enterprises take the lead in initial investments, and expansion is carried out gradually after sufficient experience has been accumulated.

hydro.title: 水力發電!
hydro.guide: 小水力發電利用水流高低差發電，常設於圳路、水道或自來水管線等既有設施，不需興建水壩，對環境影響小且供電穩定。政府以「示範先行、逐步擴大」方式推動，兼顧生態與地方發展，強化電力韌性、支撐能源轉型。
hydro.guide_en: Small hydropower generation uses differences in water flow elevation to produce electricity. It is commonly installed in existing facilities such as irrigation channels, waterways, or water supply pipelines, without the need to build dams. This results in minimal environmental impact and stable power supply. The government promotes it through a “demonstration first, gradual expansion” approach, balancing ecological protection and local development, while enhancing power system resilience and supporting the energy transition.
hydro.policy: 小水力可結合既有水利建造物、農田圳路及管渠設施，具低環境衝擊與穩定發電優勢，雖然發電規模相對較小，但因對環境影響較小，亦為台灣推動多元綠能的選項。
hydro.policy_en: Small hydropower can be integrated with existing hydraulic structures, agricultural irrigation channels, and pipeline systems. It offers advantages such as low environmental impact and stable power generation. Although its generation scale is relatively small, its minimal environmental impact makes it an option for Taiwan in promoting diversified green energy.

energy_storage.title: 儲能系統大解密!
energy_storage.guide: 太陽能、風能等再生能源有發電間歇特性，藉由電化學儲能技術先存電、再用電，提升供電穩定與調度彈性，臺灣具備完整電池產業鏈與系統整合優勢，未來持續推動電網與用戶端儲能，強化供電韌性。
energy_storage.guide_en: Renewable energy sources such as solar and wind power are intermittent in nature. By using electrochemical energy storage technologies to store electricity first and use it later, power supply stability and dispatch flexibility can be improved. Taiwan has a complete battery industry chain and strengths in system integration. Going forward, efforts will continue to promote energy storage on both the grid and user sides to enhance power system resilience.
energy_storage.policy: 儲能設施讓電力供應更有彈性，透過調整尖峰與離峰用電、提高備援能力，不僅有助於再生能源順利併網，也能協助用戶更有效管理用電，成為支撐能源轉型的重要基礎，為了讓用電更穩定，政府持續推動科技儲能，鼓勵工業區、科學園區與工廠設置儲能設備。
energy_storage.policy_en: Energy storage systems make power supply more flexible. By balancing peak and off-peak demand and enhancing backup capacity, they not only facilitate the integration of renewable energy into the grid but also help users manage electricity consumption more efficiently. As a key foundation supporting the energy transition, the government continues to promote energy storage technologies to ensure a more stable power supply, encouraging industrial parks, science parks, and factories to install energy storage systems.

hydrogen.title: 氫能新未來!
hydrogen.guide: 氫能源以氫氣作為能源來源，使用後主要產物為水，是達成淨零的重要潔淨能源。氫能可應用於發電、交通運輸及工業製程等領域，臺灣將先透過進口綠氫，同時持續推動相關應用，強化能源轉型與供能彈性。
hydrogen.policy: 為了減少碳排放，政府正在推動潔淨氫能的應用。透過把氫氣與天然氣一起使用，並累積可供未來擴大應用的實務經驗，逐步降低發電過程中的碳排放，並持續開發更乾淨的製氫技術，讓氫能真正用在發電上，讓電力系統朝向更低碳、更穩定的方向前進。
